purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches found an official Anshan public-resources notice issued by Haicheng Natural Resources Bureau for a land-use parcel procedure. The notice contains a native 宗地编号 but no open cadastral map/API. Two ordinary TLS GET attempts to the likely Haicheng government host timed out. No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was found.
registryAssessment: Local land-administration procedure custody is evidenced, so registryFound is true under the packet rule allowing a local procedure. This is not evidence of an open cadastral registry or citywide parcel layer; geometry access and runtime qualification remain held.
